sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership dominates as Healthcare and Consumer Defensive post the only all-green performance profiles across all timeframes.

Defensive sectors are setting the pace, led by Healthcare with sustained top-three rankings over 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods alongside Consumer Defensive. Meanwhile, top-ranked Energy holds ground, but broader market breadth remains narrow with only 2 of 11 groups maintaining green performance across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD periods.

Cyclical and rate-sensitive pockets are shifting modestly: Industrials and Real Estate edged up in five-day rank, while Basic Materials and Financials slipped. Communication Services anchors the bottom of the board with zero momentum, accompanied by lagging metrics across Consumer Cyclical and Basic Materials.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors—Healthcare (momentum 0.900) and Consumer Defensive (momentum 0.783)—are positive across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD.
- **Sustained leadership:** Healthcare is the sole sector maintaining sustained strength, holding a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Top YTD rank:** Energy retains the rank 1 spot with strong momentum at 0.767, trailing only Healthcare and Consumer Defensive.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Five-day rank gainers:** Industrials advanced +1 spot to rank 5 (momentum 0.400), and Real Estate rose +1 spot to rank 7 (momentum 0.533).
- **Five-day rank losers:** Basic Materials fell -1 spot to rank 6 (momentum 0.317), and Financials dropped -1 spot to rank 8 despite a mid-tier momentum score of 0.550.
- **Momentum floor:** Communication Services sits at the bottom across the board at rank 11 with a momentum score of 0.000, flanked by Consumer Cyclical (rank 10, momentum 0.367) and Utilities (rank 9, momentum 0.417).

## Divergences
- **Rank versus momentum mismatch in Technology:** Technology holds the rank 2 spot on a YTD basis, yet its momentum score lags at 0.470—well below defensive leaders.
- **Financials under pressure:** Financials maintain an above-median momentum reading of 0.550, but dropped -1 spot over the last five sessions to rank 8.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Travel, lodging, and defensive staples maintain absolute leadership, while precious metals and internet services experience sharp short-term rank deterioration.

Market breadth remains selective, with 27 of 144 groups qualifying as all-green across all timeframes. Dominance is concentrated in travel and defensive pockets—specifically Lodging (0.91 momentum), REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.87 momentum), Drug Manufacturers - General (0.89 momentum), and Tobacco (0.83 momentum). Meanwhile, Textile Manufacturing has staged an explosive move, surging into top-tier leadership across both short- and long-term metrics.

Severe weakness is concentrated in commodities and digital media. Metals have unwound rapidly over the last five sessions, led down by Silver (down 31 spots to rank 97) and Gold (down 24 spots to rank 112). Internet Content & Information continues to languish near the bottom of the market with a 0.12 momentum score after dropping an additional 27 spots. Early rotation is visible in construction and consumer cyclicals, which are climbing rapidly in rank despite low baseline momentum.

## Strength
- **Travel and Defensives Dominate:** Lodging (momentum 0.91), REIT - Hotel & Motel (0.87), Drug Manufacturers - General (0.89), and Tobacco (0.83) are all-green and sustained top-36 performers across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes.
- **Select Consumer & Financial Consistency:** Beverages - Non-Alcoholic, Insurance - Diversified, and Credit Services remain among the sustained strong core, supported by all-green breadth in Insurance - Reinsurance (0.82) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (0.79).
- **Narrow Breadth:** Only 27 of 144 industry groups are positive across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD windows.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Textile Manufacturing Breakout:** Jumped +129 spots over five sessions to rank 12, leading the entire market in momentum at 0.93.
- **Cyclical Gainers:** Engineering & Construction climbed +26 spots (rank 45), Luxury Goods added +20 spots (rank 92), and Recreational Vehicles rose +18 spots (rank 108).
- **Precious Metals & Media Collapse:** Silver plummeted -31 spots (rank 97, momentum 0.22), Gold fell -24 spots (rank 112, momentum 0.27), and Internet Content & Information dropped -27 spots (rank 118, momentum 0.12).
- **Deep Laggards:** Uranium (0.015), Advertising Agencies (0.068), and Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.077) anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** Engineering & Construction (rank +26, momentum 0.42), Luxury Goods (rank +20, momentum 0.50), and Residential Construction (rank +9, momentum 0.49) are posting strong short-term rank jumps before their broader momentum scores have crossed into leading territory.
- **Fading Momentum:** Consumer Electronics (momentum 0.62) dropped -10 spots over five days, while Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.65) slipped -5 spots and Diagnostics & Research (momentum 0.74) lost -3 spots, signaling near-term exhaustion despite solid trailing scores.
